summary: Lists storage device_type values: object_storage, block_storage, file_storage and archive_storage.
questions: What device_type do I use for an S3 bucket?
Which storage types does the resource taxonomy include?

answer_card.title: Storage device types
answer_card.answer_md:
- Object storage: `object_storage`
- Block storage: `block_storage`
- File storage: `file_storage`
- Archive storage: `archive_storage`
